symptoms_en: Aphids feed on tender leaves and flowers; leaves become cupped and crinkled, flowers drop and growth stops; they carry tristeza virus.
symptoms_hi: माहू कोमल पत्तियों और फूलों का रस चूसते हैं; पत्तियाँ कटोरीनुमा और सिकुड़ी हो जाती हैं, फूल झड़ते हैं और बढ़वार रुकती है; ये ट्रिस्टेज़ा विषाणु फैलाते हैं।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of citrus
symptoms_en.quote: Feed on tender foliage and flowers Transmit tristeza virus disease. Nymphs and adults suck the sap of leaves Wilting and flower dropping Infested leaves appear cup shaped and crinkled Growth of the plants is hindered

TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of citrus
